title: Reka AI Launches Rho-1 19B Omni Model for Unified Robot Control
summary:
Various modalities of data are processed by a unified neural network in a new research project that eliminates the need for specialized sub models. Reka AI has released a research preview of Rho-1, a 19B parameter omni model capable of understanding and generating text, images, video, and robot actions within a single end to end architecture.

The system supports real time video simulation, reasoning, and continuous robotic control to manage physical actions. While Reka AI states that the project is in the early stages of the compute curve and acknowledges existing limits in the current version, the team noted that gains across different modalities are already compounding.
